scope: Independent Chromium keyboard, anonymous login layout and approved role UI visibility on live UAT

preconditions: Approved TLS UAT; expected runtime SHA
No customer writes; secrets only in memory
steps: Open owned case on375px viewport
Open real proceeding/referral form
Select valid record then change search to an unmatched term
Verify selected record stays selectable; clear search
Run axe A/AA on actual open form
results.expected_results: New paged selector preserves selection and has accessible labels, contained mobile layout and no axe violations
